title: Portfolio Native-Signal Supply and Deficit-Day Lifecycle Value

macro_program.name: entry_signal_market_structure
macro_program.reason: The unresolved mechanism is the portfolio-wide supply of native passed signals before admission, not broker execution or risk-accounting repair.

research_height.transfer_path: daily cross-component native-signal supply -> durable lifecycle coverage -> portfolio three-starts-per-normal-day research-allocation decision

central_question: Given the already frozen structural fact that most daily lifecycle-start shortfall occurs before admission because fewer than three native signals exist, are the current admitted lifecycles on those signal-deficit days economically non-adverse enough to retain one future genuinely independent entry-discovery question rather than another capacity or post-signal conversion intervention?

lenses: mechanism: reproduce the exact SIZE_DAY to SIGNAL_DECIDED to durable-birth daily shortfall decomposition with zero-signal days retained
coverage: verify that deficit-day and sufficient-day births span every period, both natural books and all six components rather than one strategy clock
portfolio translation and falsification: compare component-period-centered stressed R and stop burden for deficit-day versus sufficient-day admitted lifecycles
research_bundle.common_boundary: All roles come from the same six immutable four-period CP2 event files. Daily signal supply is descriptive at the completed server-day level and is used only for research allocation, never as a causal intraday trading filter.

why_now.current_bottleneck: The authoritative three-lifecycle-starts-per-normal-day requirement remains unmet, but prior units separately studied risk blockers, component frequency, RC16 monthly supply and external market state without deciding whether future discovery should target days where the existing portfolio lacks enough native signals.
connection_bridge: Unit 061 reproduced the P4 funnel but closed invalid on a double-counted slot formula; this unit neither repairs nor uses that formula or candidate ledger.
Unit 074 found an unstable component frequency/value frontier and preserved the three-fill requirement, leaving daily coverage and value on under-supplied days unresolved.
Unit 080 studied only RC16 calendar supply; the complete CP2 signal ledger now supports all six components, four periods and the portfolio day denominator.
Unit 084 closed a pre-decision external participation state; Unit 085 changes program, causal object and data role to native signal-day supply and portfolio research allocation.
why_now.perspective_distance_from_recent: Unit 084 was Program 2 market participation at a shared pre-decision clock. Unit 085 is Program 1 cross-component native-signal supply over complete normal days, with a meso-to-macro turnover decision rather than another external-state treatment.
why_now.decision_if_nonadverse: Preserve all current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future discovery seed for a genuinely new entry mechanism that adds independently valued opportunities on fewer-than-three-signal days and is evaluated in the complete portfolio.
why_now.decision_if_hostile: Do not target signal-deficit days merely to satisfy turnover; require any unrelated future entry mechanism to overcome the observed quality conflict before count can be favorable evidence.
why_now.decision_if_ambiguous_or_invalid: Preserve current behavior and retain no supply-targeted discovery seed.

distinction_from_closed_work.unit_061: No P4 candidate ledger, admission reason, active/reserved slot, headroom, cap, blocked candidate or favorable-release counterfactual is used. The invalid slot formula is not corrected or rerun.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_074: No component frequency rank, three-versus-three component split, removal or causal claim that frequency lowers value is used. The state is the portfolio's complete daily native-signal count.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_080: No RC16 month, trend, volatility or threshold is used. Every component and all four periods enter one shared daily coverage state.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_084: No tick volume, price, participation score, external regime or acquired-bar transform is used.

premetric_structural_feasibility.scope: Only event type, exact component, server date and period were used. No final value_b, planned-risk division, stop reason, conditioned lifecycle economics, gate or verdict was calculated.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not a primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.normal_day: Exactly one SIZE_DAY server date within each fresh period. Keep every SIZE_DAY date, including days with zero SIGNAL_DECIDED or zero birth.
fixed_reconstruction.native_signal: Each SIGNAL_DECIDED event is one observed native passed opportunity. Count repeated same-day events separately and do not infer signals behind absent events.
fixed_reconstruction.birth: OPEN for five market components and matched PASSIVE_FILL for Passive. No pending placement or expiry is a lifecycle start.
fixed_reconstruction.daily_state: SIGNAL_DEFICIT when the completed server day contains fewer than three SIGNAL_DECIDED events; SIGNAL_SUFFICIENT when it contains at least three.
fixed_reconstruction.daily_shortfall: For each normal day, max(0, 3 minus count). Calculate separately for native signals and durable births. Post-signal recoverable shortfall is birth shortfall minus signal shortfall.
fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle: Pair each birth to the next same-component CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE under the already-authoritative strict alternation semantics. Parse positive planned risk from final detail; stressed R is final value_b divided by planned risk; EXTERNAL_CLOSE is a stop.
fixed_reconstruction.component_period_centering: Within each of 24 component-period cells, subtract the full-cell mean stressed R and stop rate from every lifecycle before state aggregation.
fixed_reconstruction.causal_limit: Completed-day supply is not known at earlier intraday decisions. It can allocate future research but cannot be deployed as a trading filter or identify the return of an unobserved new signal.

fixed_reports.mechanism: Report days, signals, births, both daily shortfalls, irreducible supply share, compliant-day rates and all four period values.
fixed_reports.coverage: Report deficit/sufficient day and birth counts by period, book and component.
fixed_reports.economic_contrast: Report raw and component-period-centered DEFICIT-minus-SUFFICIENT stressed R and stop rate pooled, by both books, four periods and six components.
fixed_reports.contribution: Report absolute period and component contribution shares for centered stressed R.
fixed_reports.limits: State that observed deficit-day lifecycle value does not identify the value of a missing or newly invented signal.

requirements: All eleven immutable files retain exact byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes and every pinned closure retains its declared verdict boundary.

Reconstruct 16,477 distinct event rows, 1,051 unique SIZE_DAY dates, 2,429 SIGNAL_DECIDED events and 2,233 complete lifecycles with zero duplicate, overlap, pending, birth, close, planned-risk or period-end fault.
Reproduce exact period, daily shortfall, deficit/sufficient day, birth, book and component topology in premetric_structural_feasibility.
Reconstruct pooled stressed net 407.0477 USD, 2,027 CLOSE and 206 EXTERNAL_CLOSE finals and 24 finite component-period centering cells.
Both daily states exist in all four periods, both books and all six components; every pooled component-state has at least 15 births and every component-period state has at least three births.
Perfect-conversion signal shortfall is at least 75% of actual birth shortfall pooled.
The same share is at least 65% in every period.
Perfect conversion of observed signals yields fewer than three signals on at least half of all normal days.
Perfect conversion raises the compliant-day rate by less than 10 percentage points.
fixed_supply_mechanism_gate.interpretation: Passage establishes only that post-signal conversion cannot satisfy the daily obligation from the observed native opportunity set.

requirements: Pooled centered DEFICIT-minus-SUFFICIENT stressed R is at least -0.05R.
Pooled centered DEFICIT-minus-SUFFICIENT stop rate is at most +0.025.
Both books have stressed-R difference at least -0.10R and stop difference at most +0.05.
At least three of four periods and at least four of six components meet both -0.10R and +0.05 non-adverse bounds.
No one period contributes more than 60% and no one component more than 55% of the absolute centered stressed-R contrast numerator.
Pooled centered DEFICIT-minus-SUFFICIENT stressed R is at most -0.10R.
Pooled centered DEFICIT-minus-SUFFICIENT stop rate is at least +0.05.
The concordant adverse direction appears in both books, at least three of four periods and at least four of six components.
No one period contributes more than 60% and no one component more than 55% of the absolute centered stressed-R contrast numerator.

fixed_verdict_rules.nonadverse: PASS_UPSTREAM_SIGNAL_SUPPLY_GAP_WITH_NONADVERSE_DEFICIT_DAY_VALUE_RETAIN_DISCOVERY_SEED when integrity, supply mechanism and every non-adverse value requirement pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.hostile: PASS_UPSTREAM_SIGNAL_SUPPLY_GAP_BUT_DEFICIT_DAY_VALUE_HOSTILE_NO_SEED when integrity, supply mechanism and every hostile value requirement pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_UPSTREAM_SIGNAL_SUPPLY_GAP_VALUE_NO_SEED when integrity and supply mechanism pass but neither complete value rule passes.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_PORTFOLIO_NATIVE_SIGNAL_SUPPLY_FRONTIER_NO_VERDICT when any immutable, topology, lifecycle, density or supply-mechanism requirement fails.

decision_translation.nonadverse: Retain one later independently declared research seed for a genuinely new signal mechanism whose incremental opportunities occur on fewer-than-three-native-signal days. It must preserve all base opportunities and pass whole-portfolio value, risk and turnover evaluation; Unit 085 chooses no concrete signal.
decision_translation.hostile: Retain no supply-targeted seed and explicitly record that count expansion into existing drought-day contexts faces an observed value conflict.
decision_translation.ambiguous_or_invalid: Retain no seed and preserve current entry, order, risk, lot, slot and portfolio behavior.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration, state and Frontier memory before parsing any final value_b, planned-risk-normalized outcome, stop classification, centered contrast, contribution, gate or verdict.

Run exactly one fixed in-memory aggregation over the six CP2 files. One implementation-only correction is allowed only before any new economic metric is emitted; after a metric, no correction or rerun is permitted.
Do not repair Unit 061, use its candidate ledger or slot formula, impute blocked or absent signals, or open a capacity, admission, priority, clock, threshold, subgroup or component-removal rescue.
Do not retain an analysis CLI, acquire data, create a runtime, modify MQL, compile, run Tester, inspect Program 6, query broker/account state or touch Live.
Close after one result, freeze the family and recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 plus all heights before any successor. A non-adverse pass retains a seed but does not automatically open it.
